scope: Historical research validation of rainfall/river-flow/flood-impact behavior in Catacaos and Bajo Piura. This closeout does not authorize operational thresholds or live alerting.

historical_cases.outcome: Piura River overflow affecting Catacaos; SENAMHI inventory reports 11700 affected/damnified persons in Catacaos and additional impacts in Cura Mori and El Tallan.
SENAMHI inventory records Piura River flow around 1500 m3/s at Catacaos on 25 and 31 March 2012 and agricultural impacts during the season.
historical_cases.interpretation: intermediate historical reference; not a verified negative control

historical_cases.outcome: Catastrophic Piura River overflow affecting Piura, Castilla, Catacaos, Cura Mori and Bajo Piura.
primary_context: PECHP operational records as reproduced in UDEP engineering studies
historical_cases.discharge_note: Use primary/traceable PECHP-UDEP values when available. Rounded secondary values in inventories are corroborative only.

mechanism_chain.chain: upstream rainfall -> basin runoff -> Piura River discharge -> river travel/velocity -> overtopping/breach/drainage interaction -> Catacaos/Bajo Piura impact
evidence: UDEP hydraulic analysis Los Ejidos-Puente Independencia using observed 2017 levels/topography and HEC-RAS
UDEP/PECHP operational-flow reconstruction around the 2017 peak
CENEPRED 2017 hazard, vulnerability, exposure and risk mapping for Catacaos
Pena-Caceres et al. 2025 empirical travel-time/surface-velocity measurements for 83, 111 and 422 m3/s

exposure_context.note: Exposure figures are contextual to the 2017 evaluation footprint and must not be treated as current 2026 population counts.

hydraulic_state_change.note: River defenses, channel sedimentation, drainage condition and other works change through time; equal discharge does not imply equal impact across 1998, 2002, 2012, 2017, 2021 or later configurations.

negative_control_status.note: 2019 and 2021 measurements are hydraulic reference cases only. They are not labelled NO_IMPACT without independent outcome verification. This limitation is carried explicitly and does not block research closeout.

allowed_uses: independent comparison of rainfall and discharge products
forbidden_uses: derive or deploy operational flood thresholds
treat 2019 or 2021 as negative controls without outcome verification
transfer one historical discharge-impact relationship to a different infrastructure/channel state
override primary gauge or PECHP records with rounded secondary values

remaining_before_any_production_consider: confirmed negative/non-impact controls with rainfall and river state
validated live rainfall and river-data latency/continuity
independent review of any proposed operational thresholds
